scope: BTS adaptation pilot: static, early-confirm Complete Cohort, Wait-All Complete
time_axis: UTC minute reconstructed labels released at next prediction event; prediction-before-feedback at ties
feedback_proxy: actual flight completion plus an ASSUMED 10-minute processing buffer
training: fixed triggering window with all labels; skip update if only one class
model_preprocessing: Step 04 LR/DT pipelines; identical settings across methods
calibration: 100 fresh predictions of each successful new version, wait for all labels
post_stream: remaining labels are flushed for historical decisions; no new model training is run without future inputs
limitations: Experimental BTS port; independently validate step ordering against original paper implementation before submission
Same-window matched differences are NOT estimated from independently adapted strategy windows
Only 3 methods here. Soft-q30, Arrived-Only, Stale ablation and fixed-trigger audit need separate controlled tests
Real flight labels, but NOT observed label-verification log times
Retrospectively excludes canceled/diverted flights, not a true operational prospective sample
